info.title: Synthetic Print Desk
info.description: Read-only synthetic print job lookup. Replace the intentionally invalid host and configure authentication before any cloud test.

get.summary: Look up one synthetic print job
get.description: Returns found, ambiguous, or not_found. Use the message and sourceId as returned. Do not choose among ambiguous jobs or invent collection times.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: An exact synthetic job ID or title words. Use an exact ID after an ambiguous match.

200.description: Lookup completed; inspect outcome before interpreting a job.

403.description: Invalid host for this local demonstration.

sourceId.description: Stable synthetic evidence ID; empty unless exactly one record was found.

readyAt.description: Empty means unconfirmed. Never turn an empty value into a promised date.

message.description: Deterministic source-backed display text. Not a model-generated answer.
